author: Phobiaxx
body:
So.. I started making a map for nebula... one that focused mainly on gameplay.. I wanted to combine some aspects of ttwo of my favorite maps..........
Rendezvous and Senex..
It was meant to be called something like "Thrice" with three monuments, and three attacking spots.. instead of 2 and 2 from rendezvous.. but it started looking too much like rendezvous... should I just scrap it? :P
